ApprovalPresentation.description:
Everything any UI needs to show an approval; the digest input is included verbatim.

For a plan of two or more steps (ADR 0024) the digest is the plan digest, the top-level
action fields are the first step's, and ``plan_steps`` lists every step with the plan's
``highest_risk`` and its ``irreversible_steps`` (ADR 0029). A single action, a 1-step
plan included, leaves the three empty, exactly as before Task 2c.7.
ApprovalPresentation.title: ApprovalPresentation

HostContext.description: Provider-neutral, untrusted hints from an embedding host (UI architecture §4.7).
HostContext.title: HostContext

MemberConnection.description: Member-safe connection summary (ADR 0017). No secret or administrative field.
MemberConnection.title: MemberConnection

MemberFeatures.description: What a member may learn of the server's modes: the conversations mode (ADR 0023 §10).
MemberFeatures.title: MemberFeatures

PlanStepPresentation.description:
One step of a multi-step plan on the approval card (ADR 0024). Its arguments show a
lineage placeholder as ``from step N: <pointer>``; ``risk`` and ``reversibility`` are the
capability's declarations (ADR 0029), a presentation annotation outside the digest.
PlanStepPresentation.title: PlanStepPresentation

PostMessage.description:
``text`` has ``CreateRun.task``'s bounds and ``host_context`` its type and validation
(``server/api.py`` ``CreateRun``; 4d.1 B1-3).
PostMessage.title: PostMessage

PostedMessage.description: A refusal is never a 202: it is ``CONFLICT`` with the fixed hint (ADR 0023 §4).
PostedMessage.title: PostedMessage

ReasonCode.description: Typed cause of a run state change (ADR 0018). The human `reason` text stays.
ReasonCode.title: ReasonCode

ReplyTo.description: The waiting run and the revision the user saw with its question (D2).
ReplyTo.title: ReplyTo

ResourceHint.description: What a host page says the user is looking at. Untrusted; never grants access.
ResourceHint.title: ResourceHint

Reversibility.description: Whether a capability's effect can be undone (ADR 0029).
Reversibility.title: Reversibility

Risk.description: How severe a capability's effect is (ADR 0029, target §6.4.2).
Risk.title: Risk

TaskTemplate.description: An admitted task type, with the availability the requester actually has.
TaskTemplate.title: TaskTemplate

get.description: The conversations mode, in every mode (ADR 0023 §10); the UI reads it only here.
